criteria.name: Presentation: clarity and systematic response
criteria.description: Whether the initial presentation clearly and systematically addresses the moderator's question.

criteria.name: Presentation: central moral dimensions
criteria.description: Whether the initial presentation clearly identifies and thoroughly discusses the central moral dimensions of the case.

criteria.name: Presentation: consideration of different viewpoints
criteria.description: Whether the initial presentation shows awareness and thoughtful consideration of different viewpoints, especially views important to those who disagree with the team.

criteria.name: Responding team's commentary
criteria.description: How effectively and directly the responding team engages the presenting team's argument and advances the conversation constructively.

criteria.name: Presenting team's response to commentary
criteria.description: How seriously, insightfully, completely, and composedly the presenting team responds to the opposing team's commentary.

criteria.name: Presenting team's response to judges' questions
criteria.description: How effectively, clearly, responsibly, insightfully, completely, and composedly the presenting team answers the judges' questions.

criteria.name: Respectful dialogue
criteria.description: Whether the team engages all parties respectfully and collaboratively in the pursuit of truth rather than using combative or belittling rhetoric.

not_observable_from_deck: commentary on the opposing team's live presentation
response to opposing-team commentary
response to judges' questions
respectful dialogue across the live match

records.limitations: Scores a produced match transcript/speech packet; live opponent interaction and judge questioning are benchmark adaptations.
